title: Cloud City: Case Analysis Method: The 6-Step Architect Discovery Framework
city_concept: City Court of Inquest & Grand Architectural Jurors

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Builders were proposing ornate marble bridges across dry riverbeds while crowded slums lacked clean drinking water.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: The Grand Inquest established the Six Civic Questions: Purpose, Budget, Flood Lines, Risks, Blueprint, and Rejected Ideas.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a builder proposed a gilded clocktower, the jury rejected it because the city water aqueduct was sinking.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Civic jury hearings take months; architectural discovery frameworks produce clear decision scorecards in hours.
